seo.title: EPC Rovinj — Church with a Pulse
seo.description: Pentecostal church in Rovinj, Croatia. A living community of faith, prayer and the Holy Spirit. Join us Sundays at 10:00 AM.

common.coming_soon_body: This page is in the works. We'll be back with more soon.

hero.subtitle: A living community gathered around Jesus Christ in the heart of Rovinj. Join us on Sundays — faith, prayer, and the Holy Spirit for real life.

beliefs_intro.title: A faith that breathes, a community that lives
beliefs_intro.body: We believe God is alive, Jesus Christ is Saviour, and the Holy Spirit still moves in our lives today. We are a Pentecostal church — rooted in the Bible, open to the Spirit, devoted to one another and to the city of Rovinj.

map_callout.title: You'll find us in the heart of Rovinj
map_callout.body: Open doors every Sunday. Easy parking, short walk from the waterfront.

hero.title: A church with a pulse — in Rovinj since 2009
hero.subtitle: Our story is the story of God's faithfulness — from a small prayer group to a living church family.

history.title: Our story
history.body_1: EPC Rovinj grew out of a prayer group meeting in homes in the early 2000s. With a desire for Rovinj to have a living Pentecostal community, we were officially registered as a church in 2009.
history.body_2: Over the years we've grown as a family — baptisms in the sea, summer conferences, home groups across town, and a warm welcome for everyone who walks through our doors.
history.body_3: Today we gather in our space on Istarska street, but the heart of the church is still the people — locals and visitors who've found a spiritual home.

beliefs.title: What we believe
beliefs.intro: We stand on the Holy Scriptures and on the classic Christian faith expressed in the Apostles' Creed, with a Pentecostal emphasis on the work of the Holy Spirit.

bible.title: The Bible
bible.body: We believe the Bible is the inspired Word of God, authoritative for faith and life.

god.title: The triune God
god.body: We believe in one God — Father, Son, and Holy Spirit.

jesus.title: Jesus Christ
jesus.body: We believe Jesus Christ is the Son of God, Saviour of the world, who died, rose, and lives.

salvation.title: Salvation
salvation.body: Salvation is a gift of grace, received by faith in Jesus Christ — not by works.

spirit.title: Baptism in the Holy Spirit
spirit.body: We believe in the baptism in the Holy Spirit, empowering the believer for life and service.

gifts.title: Gifts of the Spirit
gifts.body: We believe the Holy Spirit still gives gifts today — prophecy, tongues, healing, service — for the building up of the Church.

church.title: The Church
church.body: The Church is the body of Christ — a community of believers called to fellowship, worship, and mission.

return.title: Christ's return
return.body: We look forward to the soon and personal return of Jesus Christ for His Church.

mission.title: Vision and mission
mission.vision_body: To be a church with a pulse in Rovinj — alive, warm, accessible, and open to anyone seeking God.
mission.mission_body: To proclaim the gospel of Jesus Christ, to disciple believers into the life of Christ, and to lovingly serve the city of Rovinj through prayer, the Word, and concrete acts of care.

leadership.title: Leadership
leadership.subtitle: A team that cares for the community and walks before God in prayer.

bios.pastor_ivan: Ivan has led EPC Rovinj since 2012. A passionate preacher of the Word and a shepherd with an open heart for the city.
bios.elder_marko: Marko serves as elder and teacher — leading Bible studies and mentoring younger men.
bios.worship_lead_ana: Ana leads the worship team and Sunday services — she believes praise opens heaven.
bios.youth_lead_petar: Petar is with the youth all week — from Friday nights to summer beach hangouts.
